content:
The Observatory forecasts that today's outdoor maximum temperature will be 34 degrees, close to the 34.9 degrees recorded on the 'hottest Great Heat' in 2022, and about 4 degrees higher than last year's 'Great Heat'.

The Observatory has maintained the Very Hot Weather Warning, forecasting that today will be mostly fine, but with showers in some areas from morning to noon, and very hot temperatures during the day. Separately, while a subtropical ridge is bringing fine weather to Hong Kong, the coastal areas will also be affected by showers.

The heat wave brought on by the 'Great Heat' has made the streets of Hong Kong as stifling as an oven, with the thermometer at Macpherson Playground in Mong Kok recording a high temperature of 40.8 degrees.

In past Great Heat days, the highest temperature recorded was 34.9 degrees in 2022, and the lowest was 22.2 degrees in 1965.

In addition, among past Great Heat days, the highest average relative humidity and the highest total rainfall recorded were 96% and 195.1 millimetres in 1994, while the lowest average relative humidity was 70% in 1968.
